family: SG1 absorbing walk with SG3 confidence-lock baseline
reference_seed: current frozen class-word CA and OVAM released token; SG5 is not used in this independent screen
graph: mean row-stochastic conditional SA affinity over every head and denoising call of frozen module 15
selection: four training folds choose method and threshold; held-out fold scores it; freeze requires at least 4/5 votes and positive OOF gain under protocol v1.2
transfer: COCO-Cap is reported at thresholds selected on all VOC-Sim and never selects a setting
deferred_confirmation: after owner review and SG5: locked SG1/SG3 winners crossed with the SG5 seed if promoted and DenseCRF; no graph-parameter retuning
